positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Assess the potential benefits of formal methods for software verification at NASA's Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) program. Compare Polyspace verification tools to Klocwork static code analyzer. Perform a case study using the SPIN model checker to determine feasibility and potential value for IV&V projects. Automate the model generation process using a Python script to promote efficient model creation and testing. Document script and model's design process to provide guidance for future work on the project. Compile summer findings for future presentation to IV&V management.
